scope: RFC-CUSTOM-MCP-EXECUTION stage 1: an owner can pin one read tool of their own custom MCP server so the browser agent may be offered it behind the existing per-call approval. Off by default (XROGA_CUSTOM_MCP_EXECUTION). Read tools only. No new scheduler or control plane. Staging only; the independent security review is still required before any other use.

keep: Nanobrowser browser control, task loop, scoped tabs and recovery journal
Existing Xroga account, model ledger, browser run and lease stores
extend: Background pairing through the existing same-profile Workspace session
Workspace PCM dictation, Chrome-local action cues and redacted screenshot previews
Explicit resumption after uncertain model completion
Proof-bound one-time enrollment and revocable Chrome device sessions using the existing API and database
Authenticated optional Workspace link and owner-partitioned local history
replace: The limited page-reading default extension build

schemaImpact.rollout: Additive table custom_mcp_tool_pins with RLS enabled and service-role only access. Unused while XROGA_CUSTOM_MCP_EXECUTION is off.
schemaImpact.rollback: Set XROGA_CUSTOM_MCP_EXECUTION off (calls are refused again) and revoke pins. The table can stay; nothing reads it with the flag off.

auth.description: No change to sign-in or sessions.

tenant.description: A pin is keyed by the verified user id and the user-scoped custom toolkit prefix; another owner pin is never found.

approval.description: Pinning goes through the existing confirmed control operation (PIN_CUSTOM_MCP_TOOL) with the same authority scope, nonce and expiry. Every call of a pinned tool still needs its own exact approval card.

credentials.description: Credentials stay in the existing server-side Composio path. Nothing new is exposed to the model or client.

egress.description: A pinned read tool whose live definition (server address, auth, name, description, schema) still matches its digest is passed to the egress gate as server-registered; the secret, destination and URL checks and the exact permit stay in front. A changed definition revokes the pin. Tools named as changes are refused.

cost.description: No spend authority; paid tools stay not runnable. Unpriced custom calls are still bounded by the existing run limits.

tests.scope: Flag off, unpinned, revoked, changed definition (five kinds), unreachable server, foreign owner, digest stability
Existing control and egress behaviour is unchanged

architecture.reason: Extends the existing plugin_search / plugin_read route, the confirmed control operations and the egress gate. No scheduler, loop or control plane is added.

rollout: Staging only behind the flag, one allowlisted owner, read pins only, a $0 account. Production untouched. Merge only after the independent security review.
rollback: Turn the flag off and revoke pins; redeploy the previous staging revision if needed.
knownGaps: Not reviewed by an independent security reviewer.
Write-class pins, a per-call price ceiling and AAL2 for pinning are not built (RFC open questions 2-4).
A re-sync that changes a definition revokes the pin at the next call, not at the sync itself.

blockers: Independent security review of the pin gate and the Composio egress path.
Live staging verification with a real custom MCP read tool is still to be recorded.
